name: police-command
description: POLICE COMMAND — Three.js 3D police operations strategy PWA (Arabic RTL)

paragraphs: عفاريت أسفلت القاهرة (Cairo Asphalt Demons) is a 3D police game that runs in the browser. You play a patrol officer in Cairo, with an Arabic (RTL) interface built mobile-first. It's made with Three.js, TypeScript and Vite, and you can install it as a PWA.
features: Story campaign: 12 missions with letterboxed intro/outro cutscenes (camera moves over the city, Egyptian Arabic dialogue), plus free patrol with random calls: robberies, gangs, hostages, chases, speeding stops and…

The city: an open, streamed Cairo of about 3 x 4 km on the real layout (Nile and bridges, Tahrir and Mesaha roundabouts, Haram, Faisal, Shubra, the Ring Road) that you can drive and walk across in any direction until…

Street life: pavements and crossings are busy with walkers, shop owners at their doors, ahwa customers, vendors, groups and people waiting to cross (Shubra and Downtown are the densest, Low stays light). Humour comes…

Cairo map: the map screen draws the same hand-drawn streets the world is built from (Nile, Gezira, bridges, Haram Street, Faisal, the Ring Road, Shubra Street, squares) with your position, the call and the objective; it…
On foot: third-person movement relative to the camera, collision with cars, aim, shoot, "surrender!" orders and handcuffs.
